stemMd: Two parallel lines are cut by a transversal. One interior angle is 112 degrees. What is the interior angle on the same side of the transversal between the parallels?
explanationMd: Same-side interior angles between parallel lines are supplementary. Subtract 112 from 180 to obtain 68 degrees.

distractorRationale.d: This is the reflex complement around a full turn.
distractorRationale.e: This takes the absolute difference between 112 degrees and 90 degrees instead of subtracting 112 from the supplementary total of 180.
distractorRationale.b: This halves the given angle without a bisector.
distractorRationale.a: This would match an alternate interior angle, not the same-side one.
